R.label: Hands-On & Practical
R.text: You're drawn to hands-on, practical work — building, fixing, and working with tools or machinery. Careers in trades, engineering, or technical fields often suit this interest.

I.label: Analytical & Scientific
I.text: You enjoy investigating, researching, and solving complex problems. Careers in science, research, or analysis tend to align well here.

A.label: Creative & Expressive
A.text: You're drawn to creative, original expression — through writing, music, art, or performance. Careers in design, media, or the arts often fit this interest.

S.label: People-Focused & Helping
S.text: You're motivated by helping, teaching, or supporting others. Careers in education, counseling, or healthcare often align with this interest.

E.label: Leadership & Persuasion
E.text: You're energized by leading, persuading, and taking initiative in business settings. Careers in management, sales, or entrepreneurship often suit this interest.

C.label: Organized & Detail-Oriented
C.text: You enjoy structured, detail-focused work — organizing information and keeping things running smoothly. Careers in administration, finance, or operations often fit this interest.
